text: 1. This triple falls is formed by decomposing the fulphite of ammonia by magnella or the fulphite of magenae by ammonium. In foliation in the cold / or, by mixing together the folutions of the two falls.

parsed.faithful: 1. This triple falt is formed by decomposing the fulphite of ammonia by magnesia, or the fulphite of magnesia by ammonia, in solution in the cold; or, by mixing together the solutions of the two falts.
parsed.modern: 1. This triple salt is formed by decomposing the sulphite of ammonia by magnesia, or the sulphite of magnesia by ammonia, in solution in the cold; or, by mixing together the solutions of the two salts.
